jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

jobs.description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run. That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role The Large Geospatial Model is Niantic Spatial's foundation model of the physical world. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. jobs.title: Trainee Consultant Microsoft CE & AI (maart 2027 Program)
jobs.description:
Afgestudeerd? What’s next? Stap in bij het HSO Young Professional Program! Kickstart je IT-carrière ! Klaar voor de reis? Join the journey to explore!

Start jouw carrière als Functioneel Consultant bij HSO en geef je toekomst een vliegende start op 1 maart 2027. In ons Young Professional Program ontwikkel je jezelf razendsnel tot een specialist in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), met AI als jouw versnellingsmotor. 

Jouw start bij HSO 
Je begint met een vijfweekse Masterclass waarin je alles leert over Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft-technologie en de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en automatisering. Je traint op zowel technische vaardigheden als soft skills, zoals klantgericht adviseren, samenwerken en communiceren. Na afronding behaal je je officiële Microsoft-certificering. 

Snel aan de slag bij topklanten 
Na de Masterclass ga je direct aan de slag binnen een ervaren projectteam. Je werkt mee aan digitale transformaties bij klanten als Rituals, Royal BAM en Heineken. Als Functioneel Consultant analyseer je bedrijfsprocessen, vertaal je klantbehoeften naar slimme oplossingen, implementeer je Dynamics 365 CE en begeleid je klanten bij adoptie en optimalisatie van AI-tools zoals Copilot. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen business en technologie. 

Groei in je eigen tempo 
Je staat er nooit alleen voor.
